forumPosts.title: How to effectively prepare for Amazon & Microsoft on-campus SDE interviews in 2 months?
forumPosts.content: Hey everyone! For the upcoming placement cycle, I wanted to share my curated LeetCode top 150 roadmap, system design fundamentals, and mock interview tips that helped our seniors last year. Feel free to ask questions below!

replies.author: Rohan Verma
replies.content: Super helpful Priya! Did you focus primarily on Graphs and DP or also low-level design?

forumPosts.author: Devansh Gupta
forumPosts.title: Need help understanding Op-Amp feedback loops in Analog Circuits (EC202)
forumPosts.content: Can someone recommend an intuitive video lecture or professor's notes that break down negative feedback and gain-bandwidth product simply? The textbook equations are getting confusing.

replies.author: Ananya Nair
replies.content: Check out NPTEL lectures by Prof. Nagendra or Razavi's Electronics on YouTube. Also uploaded notes in the Study Vault!
